title: Raya and the last dragon.
lines: Long ago there was a land full of water and colour.
People and dragons lived there together.
But one day purple cloud monsters came.
Anyone they touched turned to stone.
The dragons put their magic into a shining gem.
With it they chased the monsters away.
But the dragons themselves turned to stone.
Many years later the land was broken into five pieces.
Heart, Talon, Spine, Tail and Fang.
The people didn't trust each other anymore.
A girl lives in the land of Heart.
Dad wants all the lands to be together again.
He invites everyone to a feast.
But then someone tries to steal the gem.
The gem breaks into five pieces!
He's a woodlouse as big as a car.
He can roll like a ball.
Raya looks for the last dragon.
She finds her by a river.
A blue dragon with purple hair.
She says: If you want someone to trust you, you have to trust them first.
Raya, Sisu and Tuk Tuk travel to all the lands.
They find the pieces of the gem.
On the way they make new friends.
A boy who cooks on a boat.
A baby who's very good at stealing, with three little monkeys.
And a big giant with a soft heart.
Not even the girl Namaari, from the land of Fang.
She gives her piece of the gem to Namaari.
And then Raya turns to stone too.
All the friends do the same.
Namaari puts the gem back together.
The stones turn back into people.
And Sisu and all the dragons too!
